content: Discovery call with Kestrel Logistics (Arjun Rao, VP Operations). Kestrel runs 1,200 trucks across South India and wants fleet analytics dashboards.
Kestrel Logistics signed a 12-month Lumora Cloud Enterprise plan starting 1 June 2026. Arjun Rao said SSO with Azure AD and audit log exports are must-haves for their SOC 2 audit.
Kestrel Logistics workspace provisioned in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Workspace admin: Ravi Kumar, ravi.k@anvaya.in.
Ticket #4112 from ravi.k@anvaya.in (Kestrel Logistics): asked where to download the June invoice. Resolved by sharing the billing portal link.
Kestrel Logistics asked for a custom fuel-efficiency dashboard. Logged as feature request FR-219.
Billing event: account Anvaya Technologies Pvt Ltd (billing contact accounts@anvaya.in) changed plan from Enterprise to Growth, effective 1 August 2026. Reason recorded: budget cuts.
Billing event: Anvaya Technologies Pvt Ltd paid invoice INV-20260801 for the Growth plan (Rs 1,85,000 including GST).
Saffron Retail (Neha Kapoor, Head of IT) is on the Lumora Growth plan. They run 85 stores across Maharashtra and Gujarat.
Saffron Retail workspace hosted in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Workspace admin contact: it-desk@mehtabros.co.in.
Saffron Retail wants weekly inventory reports emailed to their store managers.
Ticket #4388 from it-desk@mehtabros.co.in (Saffron Retail): asked whether SSO can be enabled. Told that SSO requires the Enterprise plan.
Billing event: Mehta Brothers Trading LLP (billing contact accounts@mehtabros.co.in) upgraded from the Growth plan to the Enterprise plan, effective 1 September 2026.
Billing event: Mehta Brothers Trading LLP paid invoice INV-20260901 for the Enterprise plan (Rs 6,40,000 including GST).
Pinecrest Hospitals signed the Lumora Enterprise plan. Their workspace is hosted in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Admin: Dr. Kavita Menon, kavita.menon@pinecresthospitals.in.
Pinecrest Hospitals asked about moving their workspace to Hyderabad to meet state data residency rules. Planned for September.
Ticket #4671 (Pinecrest Hospitals): workspace migration completed on 8 September 2026. Pinecrest's workspace now runs in AWS region ap-south-2 (Hyderabad); ap-south-1 is decommissioned for them.
Pinecrest Hospitals confirmed dashboards work after the migration. Their CSM is Farah Siddiqui.
Quartz Mobility (EV scooter rentals, Bengaluru) signed the Lumora Starter plan. Contact: Vikram Shetty, vikram@quartzmobility.in.
Quartz Mobility workspace hosted in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai).
Ticket #4520 from vikram@quartzmobility.in (Quartz Mobility): hit the API rate limit during a data backfill; advised to batch requests.
Vanadium Energy (solar plants, Rajasthan) renewed the Lumora Enterprise plan for 24 months from 1 April 2026.
Vanadium Energy workspace hosted in AWS region eu-west-1 (Ireland) because their parent company is in Europe. Admin: Sofia Brandt, sofia.brandt@vanadium-energy.eu.
Vanadium Energy's dedicated CSM is Farah Siddiqui. Quarterly business review scheduled for October.
Tidewater Foods (seafood exporter, Kochi) is on the Lumora Growth plan.
Tidewater Foods workspace hosted in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Contact: Anil Varghese, anil@tidewaterfoods.in.
Ticket #4499 (Tidewater Foods): asked how long their data is retained; told the Growth plan retains data for 180 days.
Monsoon Trails (adventure holidays, Goa) is on the Lumora Growth plan. Contact: Priya Nair, Head of Operations.
Monsoon Trails workspace hosted in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Workspace admin contact: priya.nair@ruparelholidays.in.
Ticket #4455 from priya.nair@ruparelholidays.in (Monsoon Trails): asked how to add booking-season dashboards for their tour guides.
Billing event: account Ruparel Holidays Pvt Ltd (billing contact finance@ruparelholidays.in) changed plan from Growth to Starter, effective 20 August 2026. Reason recorded: off-season cost cutting.
Neelgiri Organics (tea and spice exports, Ooty) is on the Lumora Starter plan. Contact: Arvind Menon, IT lead.
Neelgiri Organics workspace hosted in AWS region ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Workspace admin contact: arvind.menon@kaveriagro.co.in.
Ticket #4402 from arvind.menon@kaveriagro.co.in (Neelgiri Organics): asked for an export of shipment dashboards as PDF.
Billing event: Kaveri Agro Foods LLP (billing contact accounts@kaveriagro.co.in) upgraded from the Starter plan to the Growth plan, effective 5 September 2026.
Ticket #4231 from helpdesk@nimbusit.in (Pinecrest Hospitals): asked to reset SSO access for two radiology analysts.
Ticket #4372 from helpdesk@nimbusit.in (Vanadium Energy): asked to add three plant managers as dashboard users.
